checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) against the last IDT review date and make sure no events between the prior review and window start are missed.

Falls: count any falls or near-falls in the window, injuries, and whether a fall-risk assessment or post-fall review was documented. Note that she is on metoprolol, sertraline, and albuterol, which can contribute to dizziness or orthostasis.

ED visits and hospital admissions: list any in the window, with reason and discharge follow-up status. Pay attention to COPD/bronchitis exacerbations, chest pain or ischemic heart disease events, and sinusitis flares.

Medication changes: sertraline 25 mg was started 2026-09-13 for depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 of 14). Confirm the start was documented, check for any dose change, and check for prescriber follow-up and tolerability (GI upset, sleep change, dizziness, bleeding risk with clopidogrel). Also check for a repeat PHQ-9 and any suicidality screening.

Medication reconciliation: confirm adherence and any refills missed for metoprolol, clopidogrel, simvastatin, levothyroxine, nitroglycerin spray, and the fluticasone/salmeterol and albuterol inhalers. Check whether the inhalers were newly started or changed in 2026-04 and whether technique and use were reviewed.

Cardiac and respiratory status: review blood pressure and resting heart rate trends, any chest pain or nitroglycerin use, dyspnea, oxygen saturation, and inhaler rescue use frequency since the last review.

Weight and nutrition: obesity (BMI 30+) and prediabetes are on the problem list, so review the weight trend, any unintended weight change, and recent glucose or HbA1c results. Also check the TSH result given her hypothyroidism on levothyroxine.
Chronic pain and function: review pain scores, analgesic use, and effect on ADLs/IADLs. Check for any new ADL or mobility decline and whether a functional assessment is due.

Cognition, mood, and attendance: review cognitive screening results, the mood trajectory after the sertraline start, social engagement, and attendance at PACE day-center and appointments during the window, including missed visits.

Caregiver situation and care-plan items: confirm caregiver status and any strain or changes, and check which care-plan items are due or overdue (reassessments, breast cancer surveillance follow-up given her history of malignant neoplasm of the breast, and advance directive review). Flag these for the IDT to discuss rather than deciding on them.
